field.label: Sorted Filters
field.comment: One entry per line, in the form listing_namespace:filter_index, for example cms_block_listing:is_active. Only the filters listed here are sorted; every other filter keeps the order its data source returns. Do not add workflow-ordered filters such as order status: alphabetising those is a regression, not a fix. Store View filters are not covered by this module — see the README. The listing namespace is the ui_component file name, and the filter index is the column name it filters on.
